Unit 1 — Setup & Movement

Everything starts here: fork the starter, clone it, and take a character from zero to a moving, animated sprite. The three habits this unit builds — read before you run, predict before you change, tune one number at a time — carry through the entire year.

Lessons

IDTitleWhat you build / learn
1.1aLaunch: Fork, Clone & Press Playfrom GitHub fork to a running build on your machine
1.2aThe Unity Editor TourHierarchy, Inspector, Scene, Play — the four windows you live in
1.3aYour First Script: Variables & Updatefields, Start vs Update, Debug.Log as your eyes
1.4aMovement I: Input, Direction, VectorGetAxis → direction → vector → Translate
1.5aMovement II: Speed, deltaTime & Tuningframe-rate independence and the live-tuning workflow
1.6aAnimation States: IsWalking, WalkDir, Attackanimator parameters driven by code

Concepts this unit owns

This unit owns the movement pattern — input, direction, speed, deltaTime, Translate — that every controller in the starter uses, and the predict–change–verify habit every lesson after it assumes. CED: CRD-1 (program development), AAP-2 (managing complexity with variables).
